roles.summary: Data engineering, data migration, automation, data quality, AI systems and agentic workflows.
narrative: My current work brings Data Engineering and AI into the same environment.

I work across data migration, automation, data quality, and AI-assisted workflows. Some problems require Python and careful data handling. Others involve designing agentic workflows that turn existing information into recommendations that can be reviewed and used inside a larger application.
The objective is not to add AI to every problem. It is to understand what the system needs and use the appropriate approach.
responsibilities: Data migration workflows in Python, including API-based migration into NoSQL targets
Excel and VBA automation for recurring data preparation
Data-quality assessment and remediation workflows
Agentic AI workflows with n8n and Ollama Cloud, shaped into structured application output

selectedWork.name: UDPs Migration
selectedWork.description:
Developed a Python-based migration workflow to move approximately 700,000 records from an MSSQL source into a NoSQL target through an existing API.

A significant part of the work involved understanding how the API behaved, interpreting its responses, and building error handling around cases that could fail during migration.

selectedWork.name: Wellsight Toolstring Recommendation
selectedWork.description:
Built a proof of concept for an agentic workflow that recommends suitable toolstrings based on available data and the activity being performed.

The workflow processes context, produces a recommendation, and explains the reasoning behind it.

Part of the challenge was not only generating an answer, but shaping the final output so that it could be consumed reliably by the frontend application.

selectedWork.name: QualityPlus
selectedWork.description:
Built a proof of concept that combines structured data-quality assessment with an agentic AI workflow.

QualityPlus evaluates areas such as validity, uniqueness, completeness, and comparison against master data. The AI layer supports the workflow by recommending what to investigate, summarizing findings, and suggesting possible approaches to remediation.

The user remains part of the process by reviewing findings, evaluating recommendations, approving the appropriate action, and working with the resulting output.
selectedWork.recognition: Demonstrated at the SPE AI Summit

selectedWork.name: PETRONAS Data Migration & Excel Automation
selectedWork.description:
Supported PETRONAS data migration workflows through structured Excel templates and VBA automation.

The work focused on reducing repetitive manual preparation by automating parts of the Excel-based workflow and making recurring data tasks easier to execute consistently.

selectedWork.name: AEM Movie Night
selectedWork.headline: Not every problem needs to be enterprise-sized.
selectedWork.description:
I also built a small booking system for an office movie night.

Sometimes building something useful is reason enough to build it.

roles.summary: End-to-end development of AI-enabled web applications.
narrative: Worked across end-to-end development of AI-enabled web applications, covering frontend and backend implementation, AI feature integration, application delivery, and deployment.
The role expanded my experience beyond Data Engineering into building complete software products around AI capabilities.
Selected implementation and client details remain confidential.
responsibilities: Frontend and backend implementation of AI-enabled web applications
AI feature integration
Application delivery and deployment
roles.careerSignificance: Expanded the ability to turn data and AI ideas into complete software products.

roles.headline: This is where data became the job.
narrative: This was the point where data became my full-time profession.
I worked with Power BI and MSSQL across reporting, dashboard maintenance, and data transformation. Working below the visualization layer gradually became as interesting as the dashboard itself.
That interest in how data is prepared, transformed, and delivered became the foundation for moving further into Data Engineering.
responsibilities: Power BI dashboard development and maintenance
Data transformation and preparation with MSSQL
Reporting on datasets containing millions of records
roles.careerSignificance: Where data became the primary profession.

selectedWork.name: PCMS
selectedWork.description:
Worked on Power BI dashboards used to monitor PETRONAS resources, with MSSQL supporting the underlying data.

The work included dashboard development, data preparation, transformation, and handling reporting datasets containing millions of records.

selectedWork.name: IRMS
selectedWork.description:
Worked closer to the system and operational side of an existing PETRONAS resource-management environment.

The work included command-line activities, virtual-machine and network-related environments, and supporting system updates while minimizing disruption to the running system.

roles.company: G&P Professional / G&P Geotechnic Sdn Bhd
roles.headline: Where engineering became data.
narrative: My work still centred on geotechnical calculations, technical reporting, and field activities, but I increasingly found myself working with large time-series datasets produced by engineering equipment.
Some datasets contained millions of readings.
I used visualization to understand the data, investigated abnormal readings, explored historical patterns, and sometimes worked with future-reading prediction.
Repetitive engineering work also gave me a reason to start automating. I used VBA to simplify Excel calculations and Python to automate parts of engineering and data workflows.
The more I worked this way, the clearer my next direction became.
responsibilities: Geotechnical engineering calculations, technical reporting and field activities
Analysis of large time-series datasets from engineering equipment, including abnormal readings and historical patterns
Data visualization and future-reading prediction where applicable
Automation of engineering and data workflows with Python, Excel and VBA
roles.careerSignificance: The major transition point between engineering and data.

narrative: Converted 2D construction drawings into coordinated 3D BIM models, reviewed models for conflicts between building elements, and conducted site inspections to compare the digital model with actual construction conditions.
BIM introduced another way of thinking about engineering: representing a physical system digitally before it exists on site.
responsibilities: Converted 2D construction drawings into coordinated 3D BIM models.
Reviewed and coordinated models to identify conflicts between building elements.
Checked coordination issues before construction.
Conducted site inspections comparing actual construction conditions with the BIM model.
roles.careerSignificance: Introduced a stronger digital representation of physical engineering systems.

roles.company: Zafa Bina Sdn Bhd & PTT Construction Sdn Bhd
narrative: Started my career on construction sites, coordinating workers, reviewing drawings, planning site activities, checking measurements, and monitoring work against the intended design.
It taught me to work with constraints that were physical, immediate, and difficult to undo once built.
responsibilities: Site and worker coordination
Construction drawing review and site planning
Measurement and calculation checking
Construction monitoring against the intended design
roles.careerSignificance: The beginning of the professional story: working with physical systems, drawings, constraints, coordination and execution.
